summary: Executed backend pytest + frontend Playwright e2e against public URL. Core landing sections, gallery tabs, and both form submissions are working end-to-end. No API mocking used.

issues: One gallery image URL (Classic Navy Three-Piece) resolves as broken in browser automation (naturalWidth=0; net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB).

action_items: Replace or harden failing gallery image URL with a stable source and/or add image fallback handling (onError placeholder).
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend currently relies on third-party image CDNs directly; add robust fallback/placeholder handling to avoid broken visual cards when upstream hosts block requests.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ records via POST /api/design-requests and POST /api/appointments during pytest and UI submission flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL and core app flows are operational. Re-test only after gallery image source/fallback fix. Backend regression suite is ready under /app/backend/tests/test_tailor_public_api.py.
rca of the issue: RCA: Broken gallery image due to external CDN response blocked in test browser context (net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB), causing naturalWidth=0 for one image. Repro: load app, inspect gallery image with alt 'Classic Navy Three-Piece'. Mitigation: use stable hosted asset, proxy image through backend/CDN, or implement frontend onError fallback image.
